author: tom.verbeke@lumivia.be
title: Re: Second monitor?
body:
Hi Lucas, hi Pieter,

Saw the Expensify claim for the monitor. Since 16 March, hardware can't be expensed anymore and line managers can't approve it (see Laura's email of 9 March). I'll let this one through as a one-off, but next time please order through the IT procurement portal. The 27" monitor is in the standard catalogue.

Tom Verbeke
IT Asset Manager
